milestone_full: Layer S continues: 194 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 194/194/194 with a derived fence. Four curated arcs are walkable from any of their chapters — the ticket arc (179-183), the crossing arc (64-67), the eleven-stop timetable arc (184-194) and the dawn arc (33, 8, 20, 6, 51, 192), all browser-verified in both locales. A measured world census states the real size; the seven-layer census derives 17/20/18/21/10/10/10 from the 106 curated clock chips; the hub has a continuation rail past the 106-chapter clock, the stamp tracker collects all 194 chapters, the newest cards carry teaching tooltips, and the owner identity record is gated. Production-limit siege: 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx; production read plane 512/512 at 64-way concurrency. Spring Cloud edge, 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real funnel, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm. D1577 removed the Clash Verge dependency; outbound egress is direct. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1051 web + 38k AI green.
